description:
**Job Summary**
 The role of Demand Role Manager focuses on planning analyzing and optimizing technology demand across SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP based initiatives in a hybrid day shift environment with no travel requirement. The manager will coordinate with product and delivery teams to prioritize work align demand with capacity and ensure high value outcomes for clients and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end demand management activities for SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP initiatives by gathering needs from stakeholders and translating them into clear and actionable demand items that align with business priorities and timelines.
* Coordinate closely with product owners architects and delivery managers to prioritize technology demands based on strategic value risk effort and capacity ensuring that the most impactful work is planned and executed first.
* Develop and maintain an integrated demand roadmap that reflects upcoming initiatives across SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP platforms while maintaining transparency on scope dependencies and expected benefits for all partners.
* Monitor ongoing demand against available capacity for hybrid teams proactively identifying potential bottlenecks over allocations or under utilization and recommending practical mitigation actions.
* Collaborate with finance and portfolio teams to estimate effort cost and expected value for demand items enabling informed investment decisions that support sustainable revenue growth and positive client outcomes.
* Establish and refine demand intake processes templates and review checkpoints so that requests are consistently documented evaluated and approved in a structured and efficient manner.
* Engage with client facing teams and internal business partners to clarify requirements for SFDC TCRM and iPipeline based solutions ensuring that demand accurately reflects regulatory operational and experience needs.
* Partner with GCP engineering and data teams to assess feasibility integration considerations and infrastructure implications for new demand items that involve cloud based data processing and analytics.
* Track demand lifecycle metrics such as lead time cycle time throughput and value realization and present concise insights to management that highlight trends risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Support continuous improvement by analyzing patterns in demand identifying recurring pain points or inefficiencies and proposing pragmatic process or tooling enhancements that increase predictability and quality.
* Guide cross functional workshops and planning sessions in the hybrid model making sure that participants have a shared understanding of scope success criteria and next steps for each prioritized demand item.
* Ensure robust documentation of demand items assumptions dependencies and acceptance criteria so that delivery teams can plan and execute work with reduced ambiguity and rework.
* Align demand management practices with organizational risk compliance and data privacy standards particularly for SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP workloads that handle sensitive customer information.
* Partner with enablement teams to share insights on upcoming demand so that the right skills in SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP are developed in advance to meet future portfolio needs.
* Coordinate with operations and support teams to incorporate feedback from production incidents and enhancement requests into the structured demand pipeline in order to improve stability and user satisfaction.
* Influence stakeholders through evidence based recommendations using data and clear reasoning to negotiate priorities manage expectations and drive consensus on trade offs across conflicting needs.
* Ensure effective communication in the hybrid work environment by using collaboration tools and structured updates so that distributed team members remain aligned on active and upcoming demand.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate eight to ten years of experience in technology demand management portfolio management or similar roles with significant involvement in enterprise scale application landscapes.
* Show hands on experience working with SFDC TCRM including familiarity with data models analytics features and typical integration patterns used in customer and revenue management scenarios.
* Apply practical experience with iPipeline platforms in insurance or financial services contexts including understanding of workflow document management and digital distribution capabilities.
* Exhibit working knowledge of GCP services relevant to data integration and application hosting so that cloud related demands can be assessed for feasibility cost and alignment with standards.
* Use strong skills in stakeholder communication negotiation and expectation management to bridge business goals and technical execution in a clear and inclusive manner.
* Display proficiency in analyzing quantitative and qualitative data to build forecasts prioritize work identify risks and present concise insights that support decision making.
* Demonstrate capability to operate effectively in a hybrid work model by leveraging collaboration tools maintaining clear documentation and fostering trust across onsite and remote team members.
* Show familiarity with agile and iterative delivery practices so that demand items can be decomposed sequenced and refined to fit within modern delivery frameworks.


**Certifications Required**
 Salesforce certification related to analytics or CRM GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or equivalent cloud certification relevant insurance or financial domain certification is desirable

**Manager/Senior Manager, Customer Success (Enterprise) (Remote)**
==================================================================


Chennai, India \| Bengaluru, India \| Hyderabad, India
Full Time
  
**About Everstage:** Everstage is revolutionizing sales compensation in the B2B SaaS world. We're on a mission to make sales commissions seamless and transparent, and we're looking for a talented Customer Success Manager to work with our largest and most strategic customers.  

  

**The Role:** As a Customer Success Manager, Enterprise/Strategic Accounts, you are a results\-driven, customer obsessed professional focused on building strong relationships with Everstage’s largest and most strategic customers. You are able to navigate complex organizations to drive value realization of a customer’s investment, positively impacting overall account health and customer satisfaction.
You will facilitate and coordinate all business functions around a set of aligned customer goals, focusing on product adoption, success and growth. Internally, you will preemptively coordinate cross\-functional teams around customer success goals; externally, you will work directly with the customer, helping assemble key resources to deliver the appropriate experience to meet their goals.
You are not afraid to make decisions and act, especially when you face uncertainty. You oversee and ensure prioritized alignment of coordinated outcomes across Customer Support, Implementation \& Onboarding, Sales, Product, Marketing and customer engagements.  

  

**Performance Areas:**
01\. Retention \& Renewals
02\. Product Adoption
03\. Customer Advocacy
04\. Customer Health \& Satisfaction  

  

**What You’ll Do:**
01\. Be a trusted advisor by aligning to the customers’ success expectations, owning account health and overall book of business
02\. Build lasting relationships with accounts that differentiates us from the competitors
03\. Understand the customers’ business needs by defining a personalized, strategic success plan, implementing creative programs, 04\. and adapting objectives based on the insights and analytics of our customers’ success
05\. Set standards for proactive engagement, network, and grow relationships across a business, and drive community growth within the account.
06\. Ensure customers renew contracts, identifying any risk of churn, working to mitigate
07\. Understand customers’ business requirements and use cases to continually identify growth opportunities, expansion of services and tools to meet the most important customer needs, partnering with Sales
08\. Ensure engagement strategies across all customer roles: Champion, Decision Makers, Executives, Influencers and Daily Users
09\. Identify problems – internally and externally – and proactively solve them
10\. Proactively use measurements, metrics, and controls, to effectively manage the overall portfolio of customers
11\. Collect data on and deeply understand customers' wants and needs, using the data to create a value narrative
12\. Bring the voice of the customer back into the business, with teaching moments that ‘wow’ the customer
13\. Drive product adoption by keeping customers current on the latest news, product updates \& knowledge, training, services, and product enhancements
14\. Understand market trends and keep up to date with the latest developments, trends and technology impacting our function and industry
15\. Provide senior leadership and sales with account updates especially “at risk” accounts
16\. Maintain thorough and consistent customer records via CRM \& other internal systems  

  

**What We’re Looking For:**
01\. Total commitment to learn, improve and be part of our great success story
02\. Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience within a Customer Success, Account Manager or Services team in a like\-minded role.
03\. Experience managing $4m\+ books of business
04\. Significant prior experience defining and implementing success and engagement strategies
05\. Strong leadership skills within the team, across the company, and in managing challenging customer issues.
06\. Strong listening skills
07\. Ability to prioritize accounts based on tiering and manage appropriately.
08\. A customer\-first mindset – you start with the customer and work backwards.
09\. When faced with a tough decision that will help you and your team move forward, you are not afraid to step up and make the call.
10\. Highly collaborative and able to work as part of cross\-functional teams.
11\. Strong communication and interpersonal skills and an ability to build professional relationships at all levels and across the organization – internally and externally.
12\. Strong industry expertise
13\. Great emotional intelligence and demonstrated customer empathy
14\. Good project management skills
15\. Highly developed problem solving and negotiation skills
16\. Willing to get creative and be innovative to drive continued success
17\. Ability to make formal and informal presentations to staff and clients  

  

**Why Everstage?** We're changing how businesses handle sales compensation, and we need a skilled content professional to help us tell that story. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, work with a dynamic team, and grow your skills in a fast\-paced environment.
Join us in creating something amazing!

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259609 **Date posted** 09/08/2026
**GCL: D2Introduction to role:**
--------------------------------


Are you ready to turn complex, cross\-functional processes into streamlined, scalable solutions that free our business to focus on delivering life\-changing medicines? In this permanent role based in Chennai, you will shape an impactful pipeline of process re\-engineering initiatives that unlock measurable value. You will work at the intersection of operations, data, and technology, helping teams simplify how work gets done and driving faster improvements for patients and customers!


You will partner closely with leaders across functions, applying process mining, automation, and low\-code platforms as tools to diagnose difficulties and implement pragmatic improvements. By building trusted relationships and challenging the status quo, you will translate business challenges into practical solutions that deliver at pace. Can you see yourself leading end\-to\-end simplification efforts and bringing clarity to complex operating environments?


**Accountabilities:**
---------------------


Collaborator Partnership: Build positive relationships with senior and operational partners, acting as a trusted thought partner who challenges current methods and aligns teams around clear improvement goals.


Opportunity Shaping: Generate, assess, and prioritise a pipeline of process optimisation and analytics opportunities across diverse customer groups, ensuring focus on initiatives with the highest business impact.


End\-to\-End Re\-engineering: Lead discovery, diagnosis, and redesign of complex, multi\-function processes, applying Lean and Six Sigma methods to simplify workflows and improve outcomes.


Automation and Process Mining Assessment: Evaluate and define the scope for automation and process mining, selecting appropriate technologies such as AI, intelligent automation, RPA, and low\-code platforms to solve real business problems.


Case and Value Realisation: Quantify benefits, costs, and risks; build robust cases; and ensure benefits are tracked, reported, and sustained post\-implementation.


Change Leadership: Orchestrate change management activities that prepare teams for transition to launch, drive adoption, and embed new ways of working across functions.


Workshop Facilitation: Design and run process discovery workshops with team members at all levels, creating shared understanding and momentum for change.


Project Delivery at Pace: Lead medium to large projects independently or in collaboration with peer experts, balancing multiple initiatives and delivering to agreed timelines and quality.


Standards and Compliance: Apply BPMN 2\.0 for process mapping; ensure solutions follow internal standards, governance, and ethical practices while supporting virtual, global collaboration.


Ways of Working: Contribute to an energised, in\-person culture by engaging on site on average at least three days per week, employing face\-to\-face collaboration to accelerate decisions and outcomes.


**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------


* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified alongside validated experience in the analysis \& re\-design of complex, multi\-function business processes
* Proven background in delivering end\-to\-end process re\-engineering, optimisation and automation projects, with measurable business outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience assessing use cases for automation solutions using technologies such as AI, intelligent automation, RPA, Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, workflow and low\-code platforms.
* Consulting experience that goes beyond operational delivery, acting as a trusted thought partner to business leaders by, challenging existing ways of working, translating business challenges into practical AI/Automation opportunities that deliver measurable business value
* Demonstrated experience in leading medium to large profile projects/ organisational change activities
* Facilitating process discovery workshops across various stakeholder levels
* Hands\-on Process Mapping experience (no specific tool) using BPMN 2\.0
* Experience in improving service processes going through different functions across organization
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing \& presentation/ oral communication skills
* Energetic and self\-motivated
* Strong analytical skills to be able to discover and interpret business requirements
* Critical thinking skills enabling challenging process findings and solutions
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple tasks \& projects at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Willingness to undertake some domestic/ international travel (as required)
* Fluency in English

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Significant experience with various related BPM capabilities i.e. AI, Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
